comparison_policy.alert_meaning: Advisory source/recording difference; not evidence of different speaker and never a voice_identity_status decision
comparison_policy.style_riwayah_year_differences: preserved as context; legitimately different recordings can have large duration differences

limitations: Only retained complete original sources from B diagnosis, not all 69 recitations or all chapters.
No clips, HF payloads or word spans used as full-surah duration.
ffprobe duration is encoded-container duration; no new offset, crop, NCC, VAD, embedding or T7 measurement.
Bit rate/sample rate/channels are encoding properties; do not quantify perceptual quality or certify voice identity.
Same-reciter recordings can differ in style, riwayah, era, pauses and basmala, causing legitimate duration differences.

speaker_embeddings.reason: No verified complete same-reciter audition corpus; optional embeddings not required for identity confirmation and not used to decide voice status.

limitations: No listening or human identity approval; all recitations remain unverified.
Cross-reader retained B source SHA256 compared on 144 verified complete source files with zero duplicates; other links and differently encoded equal recordings remain unverified.
Opaque YouTube/Drive IDs and numeric archive/TVQuran folders cannot prove reader name from URL. YouTube not fetched.
Legacy source metadata claims isOpenLicense are not provider permission.
Audition sample selection and production insertion belong to root T5; this report does not invent durations or apply rows.
